blocks.text: The sixth annual Academy Museum Gala, held on October 17, proved once again to be a powerful tribute to cinema. Gathering top Hollywood figures, the evening raised more than $14 million for film preservation, museum exhibitions, and community programming. The event also recognized key industry figures who made a significant impact on cinema. The evening honored three standout figures in cinema: filmmaker Robert Rodriguez presented the ‘Luminary Award’ to legendary director and composer John Carpenter; Charlize Theron received the ‘Icon Award’ from Sigourney Weaver; and Tom Ford and Judd Apatow presented the ‘Vantage Award’ to Colman Domingo Making headlines alongside the […]...
